summary.text: Tom Sawyer is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 95 who has served since January 2013, previously held the seat from 2003 to 2009, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He owns Tom Sawyer Accounting Services and is the only candidate listed for the seat in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Sawyer earned a B.B.A. from Wichita State University in 1984.
His professional experience includes owning Tom Sawyer Accounting Services.
Sawyer represented Kansas House District 95 from 2003 to 2009 and assumed office again on January 14, 2013.
